verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a Neural Engine exists and is faster in the M4 family (apple-m4-pro-docs-5), and official SDKs/runtimes ship today (Core ML, MLX, Metal ML with GPU Neural Accelerators — apple-m4-pro-docs-9, -10, -11), satisfying the SDK/runtime half of the story. However, no published TOPS figure or stated precision for the Neural Engine appears anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: a published TOPS number for the Neural Engine and the precision (e.g., INT8/FP16) it's measured at.
